# Programs Two: the Topgolf Coach golf instruction internship (posted venue by venue each spring) and the corporate Topgolf Internship Program in Dallas (2027 req live; an Employee Relations intern also posted in 2024)


*Last updated: November 2026*


Topgolf's documented student internship is narrow and seasonal: a venue-level golf instruction role, the "Topgolf Coach" internship, for students enrolled in a Professional Golf Management (PGM) program. Topgolf's own career site shows it posted every spring from 2024 to 2026, with 2026 postings going up between 7 April and 4 May, and most pages we read were marked filled within days to a month. One corporate intern, an Employee Relations Intern in Dallas, appeared in May 2024, and a corporate program is back: the Topgolf Intern 2027 req at the Dallas HQ, posted October 19, 2026, is open on Topgolf's[Workday board](https://topgolf.com/us/company/careers/) as of October 22, 2026. Here's the cycle in plain words: the next Topgolf Coach postings are expected around March to May 2027, for the summer 2027 Summer Academy.


---


## What Is a Topgolf Internship?


A Topgolf internship is a student role at one of Topgolf's entertainment venues, or in a few cases at its Dallas Venue Support Center. The documented program is the Topgolf Coach internship, titled variously Golf Instructor Summer Intern or Paid Summer Intern Golf Instructor. Interns assist and teach the Summer Academy, Topgolf's flagship junior program, repair loaner clubs, sell Topgolf Coach lessons, train new associates and maintain student records in a CRM tool. We found no Topgolf early-careers page; its[careers link](https://topgolf.com/us/company/careers/) goes straight to its Workday board. Topgolf is also no longer part of Topgolf Callaway Brands, so Callaway Golf Company's internships belong to a separate employer.


## When Do Topgolf Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Topgolf's Topgolf Coach internship runs on one spring clock, while the corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req posted early, on October 19, 2026. The earliest Coach posting dates we read were 30 March 2024, 3 March 2025 and 7 April 2026, and the last 2026 posting we read went up on 4 May. Topgolf's own career-site archives list at least 82 intern-titled postings across the three springs (a lower bound, since the archive is a sample), because each venue posts its own. Start dates aren't published in the postings, so the lead time from posting to start can't be measured. Topgolf hasn't announced summer 2027 dates, so the window below is an inference from three cycles.


Now · October 2026 YOU ARE HERE


The corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req (Dallas HQ: Marketing, Technology, Legal, Accounting, Finance, HR) posted October 19, 2026 and is open as of October 22. No Topgolf Coach venue internship is posted yet.


Build proof now: the[Consumer Behavior Insights with Generous Brands](https://www.extern.com/externships/consumer-behavior-insights-externship-with-generous-brands-nov-2026) for guest and consumer insight, or the[Breaking Games E-Commerce Data Analysis & Strategy](https://www.extern.com/externships/breaking-games-e-commerce-data-analysis-strategy-oct-2026) for sales and CRM data.


October 2026 to February 2027


Confirm you're enrolled in a PGM program, line up golf-instruction or competitive-golf experience, and set a Workday job alert on Topgolf's careers board.


~March 2027 EXPECTED


The first venue postings are expected. Earlier cycles started 3 March 2025 and 30 March 2024.


~April to May 2027 EXPECTED


SHORT WINDOW — APPLY WEEK 1


Most venue postings are expected here. In 2026 they went up from 7 April to 4 May, and in 2025 pages we read were already marked filled within days to weeks. Apply the day a venue near you posts.


Summer 2027 EXPECTED


The Summer Academy runs 8 to 12 weeks per the posting text; exact dates aren't published.


*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Topgolf posts venue by venue, and the 2025 and 2026 pages we read were marked filled 7 to 32 days after their posting date, which is an upper bound on how long they stayed open. The Charlotte 2026 posting went up on 4 May and showed filled by the 11 May capture of the page. None of the postings we read gives a closing date, so there's no deadline to wait for. If a venue near you posts, apply that day, and set an alert so you see it.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


The 2026 Topgolf Coach postings set specific requirements:


• **Program:** enrolled in a Professional Golf Management (PGM) program.


• **Golf background:** a previous competitive golf participant, with golf-industry experience in the Colony posting.


• **Physical and schedule:** able to lift 50 pounds, and available evenings, weekends and holidays.


• **Hours:** part time at 24 hours a week in the posting data, though another field on the same pages says 40.


• **Corporate (2027):** the Topgolf Intern 2027 req asks for current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate program and onsite work for the full internship. The 2024 Employee Relations intern asked for someone pursuing or having completed a BS in Human Resources Management, Hospitality or a similar field.


• **GPA and work authorization:** not stated in the postings we read.


### Can You Apply Without Being in a PGM Program?


Not to the Topgolf Coach internship: PGM enrollment is in the 2026 postings we read. The 2024 Greenville capture lists no eligibility, but the program stayed the same in 2026. If you're not in a PGM program, Topgolf's venue jobs are regular roles on the same board, and the corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req in Dallas, open as of October 22, 2026, has no PGM requirement.

## What Skills Does Topgolf Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Topgolf hasn't published a skills list, so we read the 2026 posting text. **Golf instruction:** teaching and managing the Summer Academy, and lesson analysis. **Equipment:** loaner-club repair. **Sales and guest service:** suggesting guest instruction tips to sell Topgolf Coach lessons. **Teamwork and records:** training new associates and maintaining student and lead records in a CRM tool. **Stamina:** lifting 50 pounds and working evenings, weekends and holidays.


> **Note:** No skill chart: the venue postings we read repeat one program, so counting skills would only repeat the same list. The corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req (posted October 19, 2026) lists its own qualifications on the Workday board.

## What Is the Topgolf Application and Interview Process Like?


Topgolf doesn't publish an interview format. This is what its postings and careers link show:


1. **Check your eligibility.** The Topgolf Coach internship asks for PGM enrollment and competitive golf experience.


2. **Go to the Workday board.** Topgolf's careers page redirects to its Workday job board, where each venue posts separately.


3. **Set an alert and apply fast.** Pages we read were marked filled within days to a month of posting.


4. **Prepare for a hands-on role.** Expect to be asked about teaching, lifting and evening, weekend and holiday availability.


5. **Interview and offer.** Steps aren't published.


Avoid Callaway Golf Company's internship pages. That's a separate employer.


### What the Community Says


We found no Reddit thread about a Topgolf internship. The two Topgolf employee threads we found are about venue jobs, not internships, so this page has no community cards.


## How Do You Stand Out for a Topgolf Internship?


Three moves. First, be ready before March. Venue postings fill within days to weeks, so confirm your PGM status, update your résumé with golf-instruction experience and set a Workday alert in advance. Second, show the sales side. The role includes selling Topgolf Coach lessons and keeping CRM records, so a finished project in customer or sales data sets you apart from golfers who only list their handicap. Third, apply to the venue near you the day it posts, because each venue hires separately. Topgolf publishes no applicant count or conversion rate, so treat the internship as a way into a venue team and ask about next steps once you're there.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Topgolf internship?


No. The 2026 Topgolf Coach postings we read went up between 7 April and 4 May 2026, and they showed as filled in the page captures we saw. For summer 2027, the corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req in Dallas is open as of October 22, 2026, and the next Topgolf Coach postings are expected around March to May 2027.


### Does Topgolf offer internships for students?


Yes, narrowly. Topgolf's own career site shows a Topgolf Coach golf instruction internship posted each spring from 2024 to 2026, for students in a Professional Golf Management program, plus a corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req in Dallas, posted October 19, 2026. We found no Topgolf early-careers page.


### When do Topgolf summer 2027 internship applications open?


The corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req in Dallas is already open as of October 22, 2026. Topgolf Coach venue postings are expected around March to May 2027, based on postings dated 30 March 2024, 3 March 2025 and 7 April 2026. Topgolf hasn't announced dates. Each venue posts separately, and pages we read were marked filled within days to a month, so set a job alert.


### Who can apply for a Topgolf internship?


The 2026 Topgolf Coach postings required enrollment in a Professional Golf Management (PGM) program and previous competitive golf participation. They also asked for the ability to lift 50 pounds and work evenings, weekends and holidays. The corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req asks for current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate program.


### How much do Topgolf interns make?


The only first-party figure we found is $22.00 to $24.00 an hour, the pay range in Topgolf's April 2026 Paid Summer Intern Golf Instructor posting for the Renton venue. Other postings we read stated no pay, so rates at other venues may differ.


### Is a Topgolf venue job an internship?


No. Most of Topgolf's Workday board is regular part-time and full-time venue work, and seasonal Summer Academy Coach jobs are coaching jobs, not student internships. On October 22, 2026 the board listed 716 jobs, and the only internship was the corporate Topgolf Intern 2027.


### Is Topgolf the same as Callaway?


No. Leonard Green & Partners bought a 60% stake in Topgolf effective 1 January 2026, and Callaway keeps 40%. Callaway Golf Company's internships, such as its Summer Internship in Fort Worth or Carlsbad, belong to a different employer from Topgolf.


### Does Topgolf hire corporate interns?


Yes, for summer 2027. The Topgolf Intern 2027 req at the Dallas HQ, posted October 19, 2026, covers Marketing, Technology, Legal, Accounting, Finance and HR and is open as of October 22, 2026. Before that, the one corporate intern posting we found was an Employee Relations Intern in Dallas in May 2024.


The corporate Topgolf Intern 2027 req in Dallas is open now, and the Topgolf Coach postings are expected from March 2027. Get your PGM paperwork and résumé ready now, and if you want a finished project to show, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) takes about 5 to 10 hours a week.
